scripts.bridge:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/bridge/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/bridge/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path apps/bridge/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.protocol:generate: rm -rf packages/protocol/src/generated && cargo test --manifest-path apps/bridge/Cargo.toml --locked export_bindings
scripts.protocol:check: bun run protocol:generate && git status --porcelain -- packages/protocol/src/generated | bun -e "const s = await Bun.stdin.text(); if (s) { console.error(s); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run bridge:check && bun run protocol:check
scripts.e2e: bun run fixtures:install && bun run --filter @herdrop/e2e e2e
